raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Raw_transactions contains exact duplicate rows (same txn_id, identical in every column including batch_id and ingest_ts), and silver_transactions copies them through without deduplication. Since txn_id is otherwise a contiguous unique sequence (4827 distinct values across 900001–904827), collapsing identical copies with SELECT DISTINCT restores one row per txn_id, and the gold tables rebuild correctly from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT DISTINCT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
